name: Udis & Conn Orthodontics
description: An orthodontic practice in Jenkintown providing braces and orthodontic treatment for children, teens, and adults.

hero.headline: Udis & Conn Orthodontics
hero.sub: Orthodontic treatment for every age, from a first evaluation through the final retainer.

items: Traditional braces for children, teens, and adults
Retention care after active treatment ends
Serving Jenkintown and the surrounding area
Treatment plans built around each patient’s bite and timeline
Care for kids, teens, and adult patients alike
Clear explanation of each phase of treatment before it starts

story.heading: About
paragraphs: Udis & Conn Orthodontics focuses on getting each patient a bite and a smile that actually works for them, not a one-size-fits-all treatment plan.
The practice treats patients across a wide age range, from a child’s first evaluation to adult orthodontic care.

items: A first evaluation lays out whether treatment is needed and what it would involve.
Progress checks happen on a predictable schedule through active treatment.
Retention guidance continues after braces come off, so results hold.

feature.heading: Orthodontic care for every stage
feature.text: From a child’s first evaluation to adult treatment, the plan is built around the patient in the chair.

spotlight.heading: What happens after the braces come off
spotlight.text: Retention is part of the plan from day one, not an afterthought once treatment ends.
